item.title: U.P. lawmaker says D.C. summit focused on mining, budget priorities and federal partnerships
item.description: Michigan House Republicans traveled to Washington, D.C., for a leadership summit focused on strengthening state and federal partnerships. State Rep. item.title: George Washington’s Mount Vernon Celebrates Presidents’ Day, Displays Rare Items
item.description: MOUNT VERNON, VA - This President's Day, thousands of people visited the home of America's first President, George Washington. Visitors could get a chance to meet with actors impersonating Washington and other key figures from the 18th century as well as viewing other performances. item.title: UP200 Mushers stop through halfway checkpoint in Grand Marais
item.description: After 17 mushers and their dogs left Marquette on Friday evening, they reached their furthest destination at the Grand Marais halfway checkpoint on Saturday. Sled dog teams crossed the line around noon, after running 114.9 miles.
